title: Psalms 55
paragraphs: ¹ Listen to my prayer, O God; do not ignore my plea; ² hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught ³ because of what my enemy is saying, because of the threats of the wicked; for they bring down suffering on me and assail me in their anger. ⁴ My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death have fallen on me. ⁵ Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

⁶ I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest. ⁷ I would flee far away and stay in the desert. ⁸ I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm." ⁹ Lord, confuse the wicked and divide their counsels, for I see violence and strife in the city. ¹⁰ Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

¹¹ Wickedness fills the city; violence and deceit never leave its streets. ¹² It was not an enemy who taunted me — I could have endured that. It was not a foe who rose against me — I could have hidden from him. ¹³ But it was you — someone like me, my companion, my close friend. ¹⁴ We used to share deep conversation and walk together to the house of God. ¹⁵ Let death take them by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave — for evil lives in their homes, in their very hearts.

¹⁶ As for me, I will call out to God, and the LORD will save me. ¹⁷ Evening, morning, and noon I pour out my anguish and cry aloud — and he hears my voice. ¹⁸ He rescues me in peace from the battle raging against me, though many oppose me. ¹⁹ God will hear and bring them low — he who has reigned from ancient times. Selah. For they refuse to change, and so they do not fear God. ²⁰ They turn on those who are at peace with them, breaking every promise they made.

²¹ His words were smoother than butter, yet war was in his heart. His speech was softer than oil, yet every word was a drawn sword. ²² Cast your burden on the LORD, and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous be shaken. ²³ But you, O God, will bring them down to the pit of destruction — bloodthirsty and deceitful people will not live out half their days. But I will trust in you.
